ATTACHMENT 1

Resource – Assignment Details:

Number of Resources required 2 Category 1 – General Auditor 2 – Technical Auditor 3 – IT Auditor Category 2 – Technical Auditor Dates Required Field Work – 4 to 22 May 2025 No. of Working Days 30 Man days (Total for 2 resources) Location The Contractor staff will be expected to mobilize to the respective assigned location. The Contractor shall ensure gate passes are obtained before the audit planning date to avoid any delays with mobilization during the audit. HSE – type of HSE Office based Safety. Data Confidentiality – list any specific requirements Contractor shall not discuss or share any information related to the project and obtained during the Audit with any other person outside of the Company Audit Team. Scope of Services: To participate as an Auditor to assess the adequacy and effectiveness of the governance, risk management and controls of the Terminal Operations & Export process in line with Company objectives and requirements. The scope of the audit will cover the following: Receiving and Storage Export Preparation and Loading Planning and Reporting

Services required: Perform audit work in accordance with Company internal auditing standards and IIA Standards. Review, understand and execute the audit program to meet the audit objectives Document the audit testing results in a timely manner, with high quality and adequate working papers (using templates provided) Audit findings/observations to be well documented in Audit Memos with adequate supporting documentation Discuss and agree the potential observations / gaps identified with the Lead Auditor on a timely basis Discuss and agree with the auditee/client the agreed observations / gaps Document Audit Memos (within 2 days from their identification and agreement) and have them approved by the Lead Auditor and Head. Audit Areas to be covered The relevant audit or projects experience is required to cover the following audit scope areas: Receiving and Storage Export Preparation and Loading Planning and Reporting

D Experience Areas Prior experience in auditing of Terminal operations and export processes within Energy sector is required. The candidate must have experience in the following areas: Receiving and Storage Export Preparation and Loading Planning and Reporting P

Behavioral Good judgment and analytical skills (big picture) Please provide examples P Behavioral Strong organizational skills (scheduling meetings, adequate and timely working papers). Please elaborate / provide examples. P Behavioral Ability to work independently with minimum instructions and supervision from the Lead Auditor. Has (s)he led many assignments before? Size of assignments that were led. M Competence Very good expertise in Data Analytics techniques. Please provide details/examples of expertise. P Competence Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel Provide examples in support of response. P Competence Good knowledge and use of SAP ERP system P Communication Strong written and oral communication skills (in English). This includes the ability to prepare high quality Audit Memos with recommendations. Provide examples of types of reports prepared.
